text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: elevated 5xx rate from inference-gateway-us-east (service: model-runtime). Alert rule: gateway_5xx_rate > 2% for 2m.

marta: i'm on it, grabbing pager. anyone oncall for runtime?

liam: oncall here. seeing spike to ~18% 5xx, most paths return 502/5xx from model-runner. some timeouts around 10s.

alex: saw an influx of segfaults in the model-runner pod logs a few minutes ago, repeated "segfault at 0x0" and immediate 5xx responses. attaching partial log: ```model-runner[pid=1432]: kernel: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f4a8... sp 0x7ffed... error 4 in libattention.so```

jules: customer-impact: a few high-traffic customers (chatbot-tier) reporting errors and increased latency. CS already triaging; trying to capture request ids.

marta: thanks. liam can you confirm if this is single node or multi-region?

liam: appears concentrated in us-east cluster, nodes in nodepool-gpu-a. other regions nominal. we have ~6/24 runners failing, eviction/oom logs on 2 nodes.

alex: preliminary root cause: memory spike in KV cache growth during large prefix evals -> OOM -> kernel-level crashes in C++ attention kernels. we've seen similar when batch size spikes.

sre-bridge: @oncall escalation: initiating live mitigation playbook. Steps: 1) scale down incoming batch size via gateway rate-limit patch 2) reroute critical customers to backup model-variant (cpu-safe) 3) cordon + drain affected nodes 4) enable fallback to hosted-dedicated paths for customers with SLA.

liam: starting patch: reducing max_batch_tokens=1024 -> 512 at gateway. Pushing config now.

incident-bot: Config change deployed to gateway at 1849990075 by liam.

alex: launching drain on 3 affected nodes now. also flipping kvcache_eviction=true (aggressive) on model-runner to prevent further growth. issuing rolling restart for model-runner pods.

marta: CS update -> jules, tell top customers we have a mitigations in flight and expect partial recovery in 10-15m.

jules: will send note. also capturing customer request_ids to replay post-mitigation.

liam: after gating patch and kvcache change, 5xx dropped to ~3.1% within 4m. still some residual timeouts from straggler pods. continuing drain.

alex: found a reproducible sequence: long prompts with streaming enabled cause memory leak in attention kernel on large sequence lengths >8k. we'll hotfix to early-reject overly-long streaming jobs and add a safe-path to fallback quantized kernel.

marta: deploy hotfix plan: 1) quick config stopgap (reject >6k tokens) 2) backfill model-variant route for affected customers 3) postmortem + followup fix in runtime repo. who owns the hotfix?

liam: runtime/attention owner here, will open emergency MR to add early-reject and patch kernel boundary checks. will try to roll to canary after tests.

incident-bot: Pager acknowledged by liam at 1849990090.

alex: canary rollout of kvcache flag and token-reject in progress to 10% traffic. monitoring prometheus: 5xx now at 1.2% cluster-wide, us-east at 1.8%.

marta: good. continue monitoring. liam, alert if >2% again. jules, update customers: partial recovery, continued mitigation, ETA for full restoration ~1h.

jules: sent teams update + customer notes.

liam: merged emergency MR to runtime, starting canary deploy. tests passed on cpu/gpu smoke.

incident-bot: Canary deploy started at 1849990450.

alex: drained remaining bad nodes, no new segfaults in latest 6m. leaving cordoned for 30m then re-evaluate.

liam: metrics stable. us-east 5xx back to baseline ~0.4%. closing active mitigation in 20m if no regressions.

marta: great work. after-action items: - postmortem with timeline + customer impact - permanent kernel patch + unit tests - add kvcache eviction telemetry and alert - update canary policy for attention kernels when sequence_len > 4k

jules: I'll collate affected customer list and impact windows.

incident-bot: Incident marked as mitigated at 1849991299 by liam. Please file postmortem under incidents/postmortems and reference this thread. :white_check_mark:
